instruction: Open recreation.gov and verify the page title contains 'Recreation.gov'.

metadata.explanation: Simpler variation that checks if the active tab is on the recreation.gov homepage. Uses existing Chrome getter (active_tab_info) and metric (is_expected_active_tab) to verify the URL matches exactly. This focuses on basic navigation verification.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Instruction requires verifying page TITLE contains 'Recreation.gov', but evaluator checks URL instead
Semantic mismatch: The metric 'is_expected_active_tab' with type='url' only compares URLs (chrome.py:18-38), not page titles
Incomplete verification: Even if URL is correct, the evaluator doesn't verify the title content as required by the instruction
The getter 'active_tab_info' does return both 'title' and 'url' fields, so the data is available, but the metric doesn't use it
Wrong evaluation logic: Checking URL equality does not verify that the title contains a specific substring
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change the metric to check the page title instead of URL, or create a new metric function
Add a rule type like 'title_contains' to the 'is_expected_active_tab' metric to support substring matching in titles
Alternatively, use a different metric function that can verify title content matches a pattern or contains a substring
